model: 24 layers, 2048 hidden, 32 heads, 5632 intermediate, vocab 32000, 2.8365B BF16; QK norm false; RoPE disabled in BOTH modes; unfolded GPU tables; seed1234
comparison: Only memory_recall changes; same weights and timing routines. 20 workloads: original matrix plus batch32/64 and explicit 128-step generation.
statistics: Mean of three independent process means; paired two-sided 95% Student-t df=2. Order alternates by workload and block; no blanket equivalence claim.
failure_policy: Retain all OOMs; skip only identical OOM repeats; stop on any other failure or correctness mismatch.
